config.name: open-weights-muse-spark-open
config.description: Pre-registered arm B (benchmarks/preregistration/2026-10-27-harder-defects.md): Muse Spark Open (open weights, OpenAI-compatible endpoint such as Baseten) as the only model, every defect, edit-test loop vs FORGE-0. Requires OPENAI_COMPAT_API_KEY/BASE_URL/MODEL.

disclaimer: Real-model evaluation: every model output came from the configured provider; all executions, verifications and hidden-test evaluations were run in the sandbox. Small sample (9 defects) - treat rates as indicative, not statistically significant.

pricing_usd_per_million.note: Muse Spark 1.3 standard-mode list price; for mock runs the cost is hypothetical

worst_case_estimate.assumptions: every call hits the model-call budget, is truncated once, uses a schema-repair round, sends 10,000 prompt tokens and fills every output limit; no cache discount

metric_definitions.reproduction_rate: Share of runs whose target test failed again when re-run in isolation
metric_definitions.verified_repair_rate: Share of runs whose claimed patch passes the target test, the hidden tests and every previously passing test on a fresh copy (independent evaluation)
metric_definitions.false_positive_rate: Claimed fixes that the independent evaluation shows are not fixes, divided by claimed fixes
metric_definitions.regression_failures: Claimed fixes that break at least one previously passing test
metric_definitions.claimed_fixed: Baseline A always claims its one-shot patch; System B claims only verifier-approved patches
